title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_marion_duval_integrale_tome_01_by_yvan_pommaux_nicole_pommaux_msvgc (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_marion_duval_integrale_tome_01_by_yvan_pommaux_nicole_pommaux_msvgc' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, clean computer. Removing the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by the installation, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
